purpose: Validate that the 37-case single-chat segmented batch did not materially benefit from or suffer from cross-case context leakage.
execution_rule: Rerun each selected case in its own fresh temporary unpersonalized conversation using the exact same Builder blob and case input. Compare behavior semantically to the segmented-batch result.
closure_rule: 5/5 must show no material contradiction. Any material contradiction reopens the affected Builder/category/stress coverage.
